spans.s: __1 Ā (एधते, एधाञ्चके, ऐधिष्ट, एधितुम्, एधित) 1 To grow, increase; विनापि संगमं स्त्रीणां कवीनां सुखमेधते [[

.]] 
__2 To prosper, become happy, live in comfort; द्वावेतौ सुखमेधेते [[

.]] 
__3 To grow strong, become [Page0500-2] great. 
__4 To extend. 
__5 To swell, rise. 
-Caus. To cause to grow or increase; to greet, celebrate, honour; नैदिधः स्वपराकम् [[
